content: The medication is indicated for the emergency treatment of type I allergic reactions, including anaphylaxis. A single spray (2 mg) should be administered into one nostril. If there is no improvement or symptoms worsen, a second dose may be administered in the same nostril using a second nasal spray, five minutes after the first dose. Patients should be advised on when to seek emergency medical assistance for continued monitoring and further treatment if necessary. It is recommended to prescribe two nasal sprays to ensure patients have immediate access at all times. For children weighing ≥30 kg (~66 lbs), the same dosing instructions apply: one spray (2 mg) into one nostril, with the option for a second dose in the same nostril after five minutes if symptoms persist or worsen. Patients and caregivers should be informed about the importance of seeking emergency medical care when required. Drug Interactions: 1.
